Do Early Habits Predict Retention?

HardProQuerying BasicsSubqueries & CTEsJoinsConditional LogicAggregation & GroupingNULL HandlingDate Functions

Growth wants to know whether people who use the account on more days in their first two weeks are more likely to still be using it later. For each user, count the distinct dates with a completed transaction in days 0–13 after signup_date (day 0 is the signup day; use the date part of ts). Call the user retained when they have any completed transaction in days 14–59.

The ledger ends on 2026-08-31, so keep only users whose day 59 has already happened: signed up on or before 59 days before that. Every such user counts, including users who never made a transaction.

Show exactly these 4 columns: first_two_weeks_days ('0', '1', '2' or '3+', as text), users, retained_users and retention_pct (1 decimal). Order by first_two_weeks_days.
